concept: Switch is the slide switch on the side of an appliance: a plastic cap that slides in a recessed groove between two printed positions, with a small printed lamp that is lit while it is on.

default_to_avoid.pattern: iOS-clone pill switch with a sliding white knob and a green or blue track
default_to_avoid.why_not: It tells on by filling the track with colour, while P1 keeps colour for the one primary control and FORM.md forbids status told by colour alone.

default_to_avoid.pattern: toggle switch that turns orange when on
default_to_avoid.why_not: Orange belongs to the unit's one primary control under P1, so a switch dyed orange would make a second loud part in the unit.

references.source: Rice cooker with a Cook / Warm slide switch: a cap that slides in a recessed slot, the two positions printed beside it (design brief)
Braun T 1000 world receiver (Dieter Rams, 1963): slide switches in short grooves with their positions printed on the case
system/refs/ref-01.png: fader cap riding a recessed groove on tuner 1 (estimated from chat)

derivation.consequence: faders ride a groove with a ruler scale
derivation.form: The switch is a raised cap with an index line riding a short recessed groove, with two printed positions in place of the ruler scale.

derivation.consequence: every part keeps ≥44px hit area even when it draws smaller
derivation.form: The cap and groove draw 52 by 32px, but the button that holds them and the printed words is at least 44px tall.

derivation.consequence: orange appears once per unit, on the primary control's body only
derivation.form: Cap, groove and lamp use plastic, sunken plastic and ink only; on is told by the cap's position, the lit lamp and the heavier word, never by a colour fill.

derivation.consequence: secondary keys press and return without settle
derivation.form: The cap is thrown past the middle at once and eases into its end over motion.release with no overshoot, because a switch is never the unit's loud control.

derivation.consequence: a lit level uses ink at full step, never orange
derivation.form: The lamp is a recessed hole while off and fills with the darkest ink while on, never orange and never green.
The printed label sits beside the switch and names it through aria-labelledby, and the position words are printing, hidden from the accessible name.

options.name: slide switch: cap in a recessed groove, positions printed either side
rocker: two faces on a pivot, the pressed face sinks and loses its light
toggle key: a latching round key with a printed lamp beside it

variants.reason: A tells the state by the cap's position, which reads from across a room and survives forced colours, and prints both positions beside it like the rice cooker (P3, P5); B's rocker tells state only by shading on a 36px part, and C's latching key looks like a Button and tells on by 3px of depth, which breaks P3's one mechanism per part.

field.why: The printed label and the switch sit on one line along the inset, the label first and the mechanism after it.

label.why: The label is printing on the case in the regular weight at label size, with ink at 4.5:1 or more.

root.why: The button that holds the groove and the words is at least 44px tall, so the whole mechanism is the hit area.

word.why: Position words are printed at caption size beside the groove, like Cook and Warm printed on a rice cooker.

off.why: The off position word is printed at the start end of the groove, where the cap rests while off.

on.why: The on position word is printed at the far end of the groove, where the cap rests while on.

slot.why: The groove is recessed into the body with inverse light, so the cap reads as riding inside it.

cap.why: A raised plastic cap with one printed index line, the same shape family as a fader cap.

lamp.why: The lamp is a small recessed hole while off and fills with ink while on, so on never depends on colour.

hover.why: Hover darkens the printed position words one step and never lifts or grows the cap.

focus-visible.why: Every part shows the same dark ring outside its hit area, so focus never depends on the orange.

disabled.why: A disabled switch loses the cap's height and fades to half, while the groove outline stays readable.

aria-checked=true.why: When on, the cap travels to the far end of the groove and the lamp fills with ink.

aria-checked=false.why: When off, the off word is set in the medium weight so the current position reads in print as well as by place.

@media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.why: Under reduce motion the cap jumps to its end and the lamp changes at once, with no travel at all.

@media forced-colors: active.why: In forced colours the cap and groove keep real borders and the lamp keeps a system ink fill, so the state survives.

inset-inline-start.why: The cap slides along the groove fast in and slow out, so the throw reads as one physical stroke.

background-color.why: The lamp fills or empties in a short fade like a segment turning on, never a slow glow.

box-shadow.why: The lamp's recess shading fades with its fill, so the hole closes as the ink comes in.

color.why: The ink step on hover and on a change of position fades briefly so it reads as a reply.
